name: resume-matching
description: 職歴書マッチング評価アプリ。タスクの入口（npm scripts は cmd.exe と sh の両方で動く書き方にする）

scripts.setup: npm ci && uv sync --directory backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --kill-others-on-fail "uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:backend: uv run --directory backend ruff check && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check && uv run --directory backend pyright && uv run --directory backend pytest -q
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run format:check --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:backend && npm run coverage:frontend
scripts.gen-types: uv run --directory backend python -m app.export_openapi ../frontend/src/api/openapi.json && npm run gen-types --prefix frontend
